item.title: 2026-10-31 10:00 - Women's Creative Club
item.description:
Time: Saturday, 31 October 2026 at 10:00
Details: We invite women in Attleborough and surroundings to join our Creative Club every month on the last Saturday for crafting. Mothers, daughters and grandmothers are all welcome to learn and make new things or bring their own crafts along. The important thing is to enjoy the morning doing something relaxing (or challenging) and to meet with old friends or make new ones. We provide the materials and refreshments at no cost. Come along, we'd love to have you!
Location: Church Building
Postcode: NR17 2HX
